title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: 8MM Bullet
desc: Karthik, an honest policeman, chases a criminal mastermind during which he loses his service gun. Trouble begins when the gun lands in the hands of a common man who uses it to kill people.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Bhajarangi 2
desc: An evil drug baron named Araka kidnaps innocent villagers and forces them to produce drugs for him. Fortunately, a forest officer learns of this and decides to put a stop to it.

title: Dana Kayonu
desc: A cowherd loves Jummi, the village beauty, as well as his loyal bull. However, his life changes when a multinational company offers him a huge fortune in exchange for his animal.

title: Cheluveye Ninne Nodalu
desc: Vishwa, a local tourist guide, falls deeply in love with Prakruthi. However, Prakruthi's parents forcibly arrange her marriage to a wealthy businessman.
